claim_boundary: Each falsification holds only over the scope named in its own entry. A falsified hypothesis is not a proven negative for every member of its family: L41 in particular kills the geometries it tested, not kernel geometry as a subject. No hardware measurement is asserted here; the numbers are quoted from the receipts named.

falsifications.evidence: The 24% did not follow the catalog indirection. Isolating host catalog lookup off the GPU addr-probe timestamp left the gap in place. What the 24% tracks instead is dispatch topology and mixed organ sizes: the marginal cost of a dispatch (~15us for this host/catalog ceremony class) multiplied by how many the token issues, plus the fact that organs of very different sizes do not amortise a dispatch equally.
falsifications.falsifier_that_would_reopen_it: A catalog change that leaves dispatch count and organ size mix unchanged and still moves the 703->530 step.
falsifications.hypothesis: The production catalog's host-side weight addressing indirection is what costs the 24% between a clean single GEMV and production catalog addressing.
falsifications.redirect: Attack dispatch COUNT and the organ size mix, not the addressing layer. Measure the current exact production dispatch count first and do not reuse a historical one.
falsifications.scope: this machine, this resident, the production catalog path
falsifications.tested_shapes: production catalog decode vs isolated single GEMV

falsifications.evidence: Parity holds across K=5120, 6144 and 17408 with occupancy unchanged; the geometry is not mis-tuned for the shapes it runs on. The lane's own handoff names two other things: affine2-vs-q4 ALU cost in the low-bit decode, and the fact that MLP is ~54% of the bytes, so the shape that dominates is not the one being tuned.
falsifications.falsifier_that_would_reopen_it: An untested geometry family, or a shape not covered by K in {5120, 6144, 17408}, that moves the 530->337 step.
falsifications.hypothesis: The tpr64/tg128 kernel geometry is mis-tuned for these shapes, and occupancy/coalescing is what costs the 530->337 step.
falsifications.redirect: Go at low-bit decode ALU cost (affine2 vs q4) and at MLP bytes. The 54% share means MLP representation, not MLP kernel tuning, is the larger lever.
falsifications.scope: the tested geometries only. This does NOT say kernel geometry can never matter — it says the geometries tested at these K values are not where this step went.

falsifications.correction_of_an_earlier_claim: An earlier reading of this gap called it '24% ceremony'. That was wrong and this entry supersedes it.
falsifications.evidence: The gap is an arithmetic artifact of generate_greedy's Instant identity: complete-token TPS amortises prefill across a short generation as P/(P+N-1). It is teacher-forced prefill accounting, not work the runtime performs and could remove. Shortening the generation widens the 'gap' without changing any runtime cost.
falsifications.falsifier_that_would_reopen_it: A measurement at large N where the complete-vs-decode gap persists after P/(P+N-1) is divided out.
falsifications.hypothesis: About a quarter of the complete-token cost is runtime ceremony — command buffer, encoder and synchronization overhead that decode TPS does not pay.
falsifications.redirect: Steady decode ~35.5 TPS (~28.17 ms/token) is the resident's real rate and the quantity to minimize. Complete-token TPS on a short run is not a ceremony measurement and must not be quoted as one.
falsifications.step_attacked: the ~25% between complete-token TPS and decode TPS
falsifications.tested_shapes: complete-token vs steady decode, short N

machine: M3 Ultra 96GB / 28c — Apple Silicon unified memory
the_question_that_replaces_them: Not 'how do we make the same byte stream reach 703 GB/s' but 'why does this token require these bytes and these physical operations at all'.
what_these_three_together_establish: The remaining levers on this resident are dispatch COUNT and total BYTES. Addressing, tested geometry and complete-vs-decode accounting are all spent as explanations.
